name: Jabir Ibn Hayyan
aliases: Ebu Abdullah Jabir Ibn Hayyan Ibn Abdullah el-Kûfî
summary: Famous chemist and all-rounder Islamic philosopher qualified as founder of Alchemy science.

name: Hayyan
summary: Father of Jabir Ibn Hayyan, herbalist from the Ezd tribe of Yemen.

name: Jafer al-Sâdıq
summary: Islamic scholar from whom Jabir Ibn Hayyan benefited in Kufa.

name: Ibn Al-Nadim
summary: Scholar who listed Jabir Ibn Hayyan's works in Kitāb al-Fihrist.

name: Ibn Khaldun
summary: Scholar who mentioned Jabir Ibn Hayyan's interest in Chemistry in Muqaddimah.

name: Kufa
summary: City where Jabir Ibn Hayyan spent a significant part of his life.

name: Tus
summary: City accepted as the birthplace of Jabir Ibn Hayyan.

name: Khorasan Region
summary: Region where Jabir Ibn Hayyan's father was when Jabir was born.

name: Yemen
summary: Origin of Jabir Ibn Hayyan's father's tribe.

name: Abbasids
summary: Dynasty supported by Jabir Ibn Hayyan's father.

name: Umayyad Dynasty
summary: Dynasty that collapsed in the VIII Century.

name: Ezd tribe
summary: Tribe of Yemen to which Jabir Ibn Hayyan's father belonged.

name: Book of Definitions
summary: Book by Jabir Ibn Hayyan containing his classification of sciences.

name: Mevazin
summary: Collection of one hundred forty-four books by Jabir Ibn Hayyan.

name: Kitāb al-Fihrist
summary: Work by Ibn Al-Nadim containing lists of Jabir Ibn Hayyan's works.

name: Muqaddimah
summary: Work by Ibn Khaldun mentioning Jabir Ibn Hayyan.

name: Alchemy science
summary: Science founded by Jabir Ibn Hayyan involving minerals and chemical structures.
